outcome: Low back pain (LBP) intensity (Visual Analog Scale - VAS)
LBP-related disability (Rolland Morris Disability Questionnaire - RMDQ)
cohort: The study included 72 women (mean age ~35 years), comprising 40 women with non-specific low back pain and 32 women without low back pain.
finding: Decreased pelvic floor muscle strength was found to be an independent predictor of low back pain-related disability, and disability and pain were independent predictors of decreased quality of life.
mod_finding: The relationship between decreased pelvic floor muscle strength and non-specific mechanical low back pain and disability was found to be independent of the type of delivery (vaginal/cesarean section).
